description: Estimate a pregnancy due date from the first day of the last menstrual period (LMP) and cycle length. Method: adjust the LMP by (cycle - 28) days, then add 280 days for the due date. Also returns the dates the second and third trimesters begin (LMP-adjusted + 84 and + 182 days). Dates are ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/due-date-calculator/

lmp.description: First day of the last menstrual period, ISO date 'YYYY-MM-DD'
